entities.name: Arabidopsis ATS3
observations: Exact sequence match to UniProt Q9LYP6, a reviewed Arabidopsis thaliana embryo-specific protein.
Length 213 aa; estimated molecular weight 23.08 kDa; theoretical pI 6.27.
Contains the ATS3 Pfam domain PF06232.17 at residues 22–148.
UniProt annotation describes ATS3 as secreted and potentially involved in embryo development.
Sequence has hydrophobic N-terminal and C-terminal segments consistent with signal peptide and membrane-anchor or transmembrane regions, but topology is not independently predicted here.

entities.name: Arabidopsis ATS3B
observations: UniProt Q6NPM5 is a related reviewed Arabidopsis embryo-specific protein with 46.6% identity over 62.4% query coverage.
ATS3B is annotated as secreted and may interact with EULS3 via its N-terminus; these are family-level contextual annotations, not direct evidence for ATS3.

entities.name: Arabidopsis embryo development
observations: ATS3 is annotated with GO biological process GO:0009793, embryo development ending in seed dormancy.
